# Mohsin Qureshi — AI Architect & Forward Deployment Engineer

> Mohsin Qureshi is a Tier-1 AI Architect and Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE). Remote • Available worldwide for enterprise advisory & engineering contracts. He specializes in designing deterministic, high-concurrency generative AI platforms, zero-hallucination grounded RAG systems, and sub-40ms multi-model routing architectures for enterprise scale. Track record includes Flipkart, Accenture, Novartis, and TCS.

## Core Specializations & Architecture Pillars

- **High-Concurrency Model Routing**: Two-tier routing architecture isolating lightweight SLMs from heavy LLMs, delivering sub-40ms p99 latency SLAs under peak traffic (engineered at Flipkart flash-sale scale).
- **Zero-Hallucination Grounded RAG**: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (BM25 lexical + dense vector embeddings) with cross-encoder reranking and sentence-level bounding PDF character offsets (<0.5% hallucination risk at Novartis & Accenture).
- **Production LLMOps & Cost Optimization**: Pydantic schema repair, deterministic caching with Redis, asynchronous queueing, and intelligent tier routing delivering -72% reduction in cloud inference bills.
- **Multi-Domain AI Engineering**: Clinical entity extraction (90%+ clinical NER), streaming telco security telemetry (streaming anomaly detection 100k+ events/sec), real-time edge computer vision safety (PyTorch 60 FPS), and digital twin simulation (TCS TwinX).

## Enterprise Architecture Benchmarks & SLAs

- System Availability SLA: 99.98% (High-Concurrency Systems)
- Enterprise Bracket: Top 1% Architect (Forward Deployment Tier)
- Hallucination Risk: < 0.5% (Strict Citation Guardrails)
- Inference Cost Delta: -72% (Deterministic Gateway ROI)
